news.headline: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
news.summary: Vantora (formerly UP.Labs) is building startups *for* industrial corporations rather than waiting for founders to approach them. The platform-as-a-startup model lets enterprises launch AI-powered ventures without starting from scratch. Fresh $100M in funding signals serious investor confidence in the factory-floor AI bet.

news.headline: VanEck criticizes Metaplanet over executive dilution despite compensation cuts
news.summary: VanEck flags Metaplanet's executive pay structure as excessive relative to peers, despite a 41% reduction in the potential share pool. The fund manager argues that equity dilution remains a concern even after compensation cuts, raising questions about governance at the Bitcoin-focused firm.

educational.title: Why Company Earnings Move Stock Prices So Much
points: Stock prices reflect expectations — earnings reports test if those expectations were right
Beating profit estimates doesn't guarantee a stock rises if guidance disappoints
'Guidance' — a company's own forecast — often matters more than the past quarter
Markets move on the surprise, not the number itself
This is why a profitable company's stock can still crash on earnings day
